anomalies.observed: On the FCC Peripherals sheet, the PCA9685PW address pin A0 (pin 1) is tied to +3.3V, while A1 to A5 are tied to GND. The sheet note beside the driver reads "I2C address: 0x41", which is the address with A0 high.
anomalies.expected: The specification lists the PWM driver at I2C address 0x40, which corresponds to all address pins (A0 to A5) tied low. Its "PWM Driver" source is cited as the note on this sheet.

evidence.quote: PWM/servo driver | FCCPeripherals | NXP PCA9685PW (I2C 16-ch PWM), I2C addr 0x40 | `FCCPeripherals.sch` note "PWM Driver"
FCCPeripherals sheet (page 5): U2 PCA9685PW, pin A0 1 labelled +3.3V, pins A1 to A5 labelled GND; note "I2C address: 0x41"

anomalies.impact: The FCC firmware expecting the PCA9685 at 0x40 would receive no acknowledgement from the servo driver, so no PWM output would be generated on the servo connector.

parsed.summary: The schematic strap on the PCA9685PW (A0 tied high, note reads 0x41) conflicts with the specification's stated 0x40 address for the servo driver. The rest of the power, feedback, passive values and sensor wiring I could check appear consistent with the specification.
